newsitem.title: USA: Medical Industries investors lose in court.
newsitem.headline: Medical Industries investors lose in court.

text.p: Medical Industries of America Inc said Tuesday that a group of offshore investors was denied a preliminary injunction that would have forced the company to issue one million shares of stock.

In documents filed with the U.S. District Court of the Southern District of New York, those plaintiffs, participants in the company's recent rights offering, had asked the court to make Medical Industries issue more than one million shares of common stock to cover their inability to deliver shares which they previously sold, said the company.

The court, said the company, ruled that the investors had failed to demonstrate that they would suffer irreparable harm without the injunction, and had also failed to make the required substantial showing of likelihood of success on the merits.
The court also ruled, said the company, that the plaintiffs were seeking extraordinary judicial relief to resolve their contract dispute rather than pursuing the normal course of litigation.
Medical Industries of America Inc provides diagnostic and therapeutic healthcare services to the surgical and medical community.
